messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] timing myself out on release today
parts:
On Wednesday, October 24, 2012 4:11:28 PM UTC-4, Daniel Lee wrote:
> For instance, are we going to do anything with the
> diffs version of the manual Ben's been working on?
> Are we going to put two copies up or what?

I would want to put up two versions. One version of the manual should
always be a stand-alone manual.

Two manuals is fine with me, although there shouldn't be any differences except the bars in the margin and the backpage. The only thing is that someone who has the Lucinda font has to compile the diff'ed version for me, which means they have to follow these steps.

cd src/docs/stan-reference
./diff.sh v1.0.2 v1.0.3
cd ../../..
git apply alltt_patch_that_Ben_will_send_you.patch # but do not commit it
make clean-all
make manual
git reset --hard HEAD
# upload compiled PDF to website

The diff.sh is already pushed. I am just waiting for the v1.0.3 tag so that I can recreate the alltt*.patch that is about 5 lines.

Ben
